title: Bloodwood Crossbow
html:
Crafted (Bowyer Lv 71)

Skill needed

Wielding it takes the Crossbow weapon skill. No class starts with it. To learn it, finish the quest The Heavy Bow (the Archery Vendor by the targets in Underleaf, any class, level 10): free, and you keep the skill for good.

See Weapon skills & specials for how the skill levels and what it unlocks.

How to get it

Crafted with Bowyer at level 71 (34148 XP) from 8× Bloodwood Wood, 17× Frostwool.

Guides: Bowyer
